=== INICIO PARTE 1 DE 4 (NO RESPONDER TODAVÍA, ESPERA LAS 4 PARTES) ===
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, maximum-scale=1.0">
    <title>Mi RPG Pixel Art</title>
    <style>
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
            -webkit-touch-callout: none;
        }

        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background-color: #000;
            overflow: hidden;
            width: 100vw;
            width: 100dvw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            position: relative;
            touch-action: none;
            font-family: sans-serif;
        }

        canvas {
            display: block;
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            width: 100dvw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
            image-rendering: crisp-edges;
            background-color: #2e8b57;
        }

        .menu-screen {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            width: 100dvw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            background: rgba(15, 15, 20, 0.92);
            z-index: 200;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 10px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .menu-screen.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .game-title {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #ffcc00;
            text-shadow: 2px 2px #000;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .menu-btn {
            width: 260px;
            max-width: 80vw;
            height: 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #555, #333);
            border: 2px solid #111;
            border-top: 2px solid #777;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            margin: 5px 0;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px #000;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .menu-btn:active {
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #333, #444);
        }

        .menu-panel {
            width: 94vw;
            max-width: 580px;
            height: 85vh;
            height: 85dvh;
            max-height: 380px;
            background: #222;
            border: 3px solid #444;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
        }

        .panel-header {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px #000;
        }

        .world-list {
            flex: 1;
            background: #111;
            border: 2px inset #333;
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 6px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .world-item {
            background: #2a2a2a;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .world-item.selected {
            border-color: #ffcc00;
            background: #333322;
        }

        .world-info span { display: block; }
        .world-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffcc00; }
        .world-seed { font-size: 9px; color: #aaa; }

        .panel-footer-btns {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-top: 8px;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .small-btn {
            flex: 1;
            height: 34px;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #555, #333);
            border: 2px solid #111;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .form-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .form-group label {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #ccc;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .form-group input {
            background: #111;
            border: 2px solid #444;
            color: #fff;
            padding: 6px;
            font-size: 12px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            outline: none;
        }

        .option-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            background: #2a2a2a;
            padding: 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 11px;
        }
        .option-row input[type="range"] { width: 130px; }

        #gameUI {
            display: none;
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            width: 100dvw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 50;
        }

        .controls-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            width: 100dvw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 15px 30px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .btn-group {
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        .dpad {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 55px);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 55px);
            gap: 3px;
        }

        .action-panel {
            pointer-events: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .btn {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        #up { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        #left { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
        #right { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; }
        #down { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }

        .dpad-btn {
            width: 55px;
            height: 55px;
            transition: filter 0.1s ease, opacity 0.1s ease;
        }

        .dpad-btn img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .dpad-btn.pressed {
            filter: brightness(1.4) drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.6));
            opacity: 0.8;
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        .action-btn {
            width: 75px;  
            height: 75px; 
            border-radius: 50%;
            background-color: rgba(255, 87, 34, 0.35);
            border: 2px solid #ff5722;
            color: white;
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: bold;
            pointer-events: auto;
            transition: background-color 0.1s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
        }

        .action-btn.pressed {
            background-color: rgba(255, 87, 34, 0.85) !important;
            border-color: #ff9800;
            transform: scale(0.92);
        }

        .interaction-btn {
            display: none;
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background-color: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.5);
            border: 2px solid #4caf50;
            color: white;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: bold;
            pointer-events: auto;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: background-color 0.1s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
        }

        .interaction-btn.pressed {
            background-color: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.9) !important;
            border-color: #81c784;
            transform: scale(0.92);
        }

        .bottom-ui-container {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 12px; 
            left: 50%;    
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            pointer-events: auto;
            z-index: 50;
        }

        .hotbar {
            width: 290px;
            max-width: 75vw;
            background-image: url('data:image/png;base64,');
            background-size: 100% 100%;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(9, 1fr);
            padding: 3px;
            gap: 2px;
        }

        .slot {
            width: 100%;
            aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 2px;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .slot img {
            width: 75%;
            height: 75%;
            object-fit: contain;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .slot span {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 1px;
            right: 2px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .slot.active {
            border: 2px solid white;
            background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
        }

        .inv-open-btn {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            background-image: url('data:image/png;base64,');
            background-size: cover;
            background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            border: 2px solid #888;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .inv-open-btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        .pause-btn {
            position: fixed;
            top: 10px;
            right: 15px;
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            border: 2px solid #888;
            color: white;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 14px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            z-index: 60;
            pointer-events: auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .inventory-modal, .worktable-modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            width: 100dvw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
            z-index: 100;
            pointer-events: auto;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 4px;
        }

        .inventory-window, .worktable-window {
            width: 98vw;
            max-width: 720px;
            background-color: #c6c6c6;
            border: 4px solid #373737;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            padding: 8px;
            gap: 6px;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        .close-inv {
            position: absolute;
            top: 4px;
            right: 8px;
            background: #d32f2f;
            color: white;
            border: 2px solid #555;
            font-weight: bold;
            padding: 1px 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 3px;
            font-size: 11px;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .inv-col-left {
            flex: 0.7;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
            background: #8b8b8b;
            padding: 5px;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        .search-box {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            background: #fff;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            padding: 3px;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .search-box input {
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            width: 100%;
            font-size: 9px;
            background: transparent;
        }
        .category-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .cat-btn {
            background: #c6c6c6;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            padding: 5px;
            font-size: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-align: left;
        }
        .cat-btn:active, .cat-btn.active { background: #a3a3a3; border-color: #ffeb3b; }

        .inv-col-center {
            flex: 2.9;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            background: #8b8b8b;
            padding: 6px;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            border-radius: 4px;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .inv-section-title {
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #222;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .inv-grid-27 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(9, 1fr);
            gap: 3px;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .inv-separator {
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background-color: #222;
            margin: 3px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #555;
        }

        .inv-hotbar-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(9, 1fr);
            gap: 3px;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .inv-slot-item, .craft-slot, .wt-slot {
            background-color: #8b8b8b;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            border-radius: 2px;
            width: 100%;
            aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; 
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            touch-action: none;
        }
        .inv-slot-item img, .craft-slot img, .wt-slot img, .craft-output img, .wt-output img {
            width: 75%;
            height: 75%;
            object-fit: contain;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .inv-slot-item span, .craft-slot span, .wt-slot span, .craft-output span, .wt-output span {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 1px;
            right: 2px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .inv-slot-item.selected {
            border: 2px solid #ffeb3b !important;
            background-color: rgba(255, 235, 59, 0.3);
        }

        #cursorItem {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9999;
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        #cursorItem img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: contain;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
        }
        #cursorItem span {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 1px;
            right: 2px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #000;
        }

        .inv-col-right {
            flex: 1.1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
            background: #8b8b8b;
            padding: 5px;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            border-radius: 4px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .crafting-area {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            background: #c6c6c6;
            padding: 5px;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        .craft-grid-2x2 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 28px);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 28px);
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .craft-arrow {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #373737;
        }
        .craft-output-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 2px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .craft-output {
            width: 34px;
            height: 34px;
            background: #8b8b8b;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .craft-all-btn {
            width: 34px;
            height: 16px;
            background: #555;
            border: 2px solid #222;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 7px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 2px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px #000;
        }
        .craft-all-btn:active {
            background: #333;
        }

        .recipes-category-container {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: #c6c6c6;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            padding: 4px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .recipe-item-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            background: #8b8b8b;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            padding: 3px;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .recipe-item-row:active {
            background: #666;
        }
        .recipe-item-row img {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            object-fit: contain;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
        }

        .worktable-grid-3x3 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 26px);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 26px);
            gap: 2px;
        }

        #customSplitModal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            z-index: 300;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .split-box {
            background: #c6c6c6;
            border: 3px solid #373737;
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            width: 260px;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        }
        .split-box h4 {
            margin: 0 0 8px 0;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #222;
        }
        .split-input {
            width: 100%;
            background: #fff;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            padding: 5px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            outline: none;
        }
        .split-quick-buttons {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        .split-quick-buttons button {
            background: #777;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            color: white;
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: bold;
            padding: 4px 0;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }
        .split-quick-buttons button.active {
            background: #ffcc00;
            color: #000;
            border-color: #000;
        }
        .split-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .split-actions button {
            flex: 1;
            height: 30px;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: bold;
            background: #8b8b8b;
            border: 2px solid #373737;
            color: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        .split-actions button:active { background: #555; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>
    <div id="cursorItem"></div>

    <div id="customSplitModal">
        <div class="split-box">
            <h4>SEPARAR CANTIDAD</h4>
            <input type="number" id="splitInputNumber" class="split-input" min="1" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*">
            <div class="split-quick-buttons">
                <button id="btnDiv2" onclick="setModificadorDiv(1, 'btnDiv2')">1 Slot</button>
                <button id="btnDiv3" onclick="setModificadorDiv(2, 'btnDiv3')">x2 Slots</button>
                <button id="btnDivX2" onclick="setModificadorDiv(3, 'btnDivX2')">x3 Slots</button>
                <button id="btnDivX3" onclick="setModificadorDiv(4, 'btnDivX3')">x4 Slots</button>
            </div>
            <div class="split-actions">
                <button onclick="confirmarCustomSplit()" style="background: #2e8b57;">Aceptar</button>
                <button onclick="cerrarCustomSplitModal()" style="background: #a33;">Cancelar</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MESA DE TRABAJO -->
    <div class="worktable-modal" id="worktableModal">
        <div class="worktable-window">
            <button class="close-inv" onclick="toggleWorktable()">X</button>
            
            <div class="inv-col-left">
                <div class="search-box">
                    <span>🔍</span>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Buscar...">
                </div>
                <div class="category-list">
                    <button class="cat-btn active" onclick="seleccionarCategoria('todos', 'wt')">📦 Todos</button>
                    <button class="cat-btn" onclick="seleccionarCategoria('madera', 'wt')">🪵 Madera</button>
                    <button class="cat-btn" onclick="seleccionarCategoria('tools', 'wt')">⛏️ Tools</button>
                    <button class="cat-btn" onclick="seleccionarCategoria('bloques', 'wt')">🧱 Bloques</button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="inv-col-center">
                <div>
                    <div class="inv-section-title">INVENTARIO (27 SLOTS)</div>
                    <div class="inv-grid-27" id="wtInvGrid27"></div>
                </div>

                <div class="inv-separator"></div>

                <div>
                    <div class="inv-section-title">SLOTS PRINCIPALES (HOTBAR)</div>
                    <div class="inv-hotbar-grid" id="wtInvHotbarGrid"></div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="inv-col-right">
                <div style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; color: #373737;">MESA (3x3)</div>
                <div class="crafting-area" style="padding: 3px;">
                    <div class="worktable-grid-3x3" id="wtGrid"></div>
                    <div class="craft-arrow">➔</div>
                    <div class="craft-output-container">
                        <div class="craft-output" id="wtOutput" onclick="recolectarWorktable(false)"></div>
                        <button class="craft-all-btn" onclick="recolectarWorktable(true)">TODO</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; color: #373737;">RECETAS RÁPIDAS</div>
                <div class="recipes-category-container" id="wtRecipesContainer"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="menu-screen active" id="screenMain">
        <div class="game-title">MYTHIC RPG 2D</div>
        <button class="menu-btn" onclick="abrirSelectorMundos()">JUGAR</button>
        <button class="menu-btn" onclick="abrirOpciones()">OPCIONES</button>
        <button class="menu-btn" onclick="salirJuego()">SALIR</button>
    </div>

    <div class="menu-screen" id="screenWorlds">
        <div class="menu-panel">
            <div class="panel-header">SELECCIONAR MUNDO</div>
            <div class="world-list" id="worldListContainer"></div>
            <div class="panel-footer-btns">
                <button class="small-btn" onclick="entrarMundoSeleccionado()">Jugar Mundo</button>
                <button class="small-btn" onclick="abrirCrearMundo()">Crear Nuevo</button>
                <button class="small-btn" style="background: #a33;" onclick="eliminarMundoSeleccionado()">Eliminar</button>
                <button class="small-btn" onclick="volverMenuPrincipal()">Volver</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="menu-screen" id="screenCreateWorld">
        <div class="menu-panel" style="max-width: 450px; height: auto;">
            <div class="panel-header">CREAR NUEVO MUNDO</div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>NOMBRE DEL MUNDO</label>
                <input type="text" id="inputWorldName" value="Mi Aventura">
            </div>
            <div class="form-group">
                <label>SEMILLA (SEED)</label>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 5px;">
                    <input type="text" id="inputWorldSeed" value="12345" style="flex:1;">
                    <button class="small-btn" style="width: 80px;" onclick="generarSeedAleatoria()">Aleatoria</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="panel-footer-btns">
                <button class="small-btn" style="background: #2e8b57;" onclick="crearYEntrarMundo()">¡Crear Mundo!</button>
                <button class="small-btn" onclick="abrirSelectorMundos()">Cancelar</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="menu-screen" id="screenOptions">
        <div class="menu-panel" style="max-width: 450px; height: auto;">
            <div class="panel-header">OPCIONES</div>
            <div class="option-row">
                <span>Volumen General</span>
                <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="80">
            </div>
            <div class="option-row">
                <span>Escala de Gráficos (Zoom)</span>
                <input type="range" min="1" max="2" step="0.1" value="1.4" id="zoomRange" oninput="cambiarZoom(this.value)">
            </div>
            <div class="panel-footer-btns" style="margin-top: 15px;">
                <button class="small-btn" onclick="volverMenuPrincipal()">Guardar y Volver</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="gameUI">
        <button class="pause-btn" onclick="pausarJuego()">⏸</button>

        <div class="controls-overlay">
            <div class="btn-group dpad">
                <div></div>
                <div class="btn dpad-btn" id="up"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Up"></div>
                <div></div>
                <div class="btn dpad-btn" id="left"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Left"></div>
                <div></div>
                <div class="btn dpad-btn" id="right"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Right"></div>
                <div></div>
                <div class="btn dpad-btn" id="down"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Down"></div>
                <div></div>
            </div>

            <div class="action-panel">
                <div class="btn action-btn" id="actionBtn">A</div>
                <div class="btn interaction-btn" id="interactBtn">🛠️</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="bottom-ui-container">
            <div class="hotbar" id="hotbar">
                <div class="slot active" onclick="seleccionarSlot(0)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(1)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(2)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(3)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(4)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(5)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(6)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(7)"></div>
                <div class="slot" onclick="seleccionarSlot(8)"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="inv-open-btn" onclick="toggleInventario()"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- INVENTARIO PRINCIPAL -->
    <div class="inventory-modal" id="invModal">
        <div class="inventory-window" id="invWindow">
            <button class="close-inv" onclick="toggleInventario()">X</button>
            
            <div class="inv-col-left">
                <div class="search-box">
                    <span>🔍</span>
                    <input type="text" placeholder="Buscar...">
                </div>
                <div class="category-list">
                    <button class="cat-btn active" onclick="seleccionarCategoria('todos', 'inv')">📦 Todos</button>
                    <button class="cat-btn" onclick="seleccionarCategoria('madera', 'inv')">🪵 Madera</button>

                        <button class="craft-all-btn" onclick="recolectarCrafting(true)">TODO</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; color: #373737;">RECETAS RÁPIDAS</div>
                <div class="recipes-category-container" id="invRecipesContainer"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
